description: Intent i028 (timer-dwork-softirq-lock, snapshot s13) complete. Three credible findings written to agent-state/findings/i028.json, all verified line-by-line in snapshots/s13 this session: (1) net/bridge/br_multicast.c:1108-1134 — br->multicast_lock taken with plain spin_lock at 1112 (br_multicast_enable_port, caller br_stp.c:462) and 1123 (br_multicast_disable_port, caller br_stp_if.c:121) in process context while six TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks take the same lock plainly (group_expired:248 timer_setup:705, port_group_expired:311 timer_setup:732, router_expired:854 timer_setup:1050, local_router_expired:882 timer_setup:1990, querier_expired:896 timer_setup:1992-1999, port_query_expired:1004 timer_setup:1052/1055); sibling process sites 1075/2042/2061/2076/2183/2233/2246/2280/2324/2343 use spin_lock_bh, proving mixed discipline (medium confidence). (2) drivers/scsi/libiscsi.c:2114-2135 — session->frwd_lock taken plainly in TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks iscsi_check_transport_timeouts (2120, timer_setup 2940) and iscsi_tmf_timedout (1823, timer_setup 2964) vs the scsi .eh_timed_out hook iscsi_eh_cmd_timed_out taking the same lock plainly at 1980 in BH-enabled kworker context; 26 sibling sites in the file use spin_lock_bh (medium confidence). (3) drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/sge.c:1343-1355 — adap->ptp_lock taken plainly by TIMER_SOFTIRQ callback sge_tx_timer_cb (sge.c:3310, timer_setup 4131, T5+ ptptxq reclaim) vs plain spin_lock in cxgb4_eth_xmit (sge.c:1346, ptp_enabled branch, .ndo_start_xmit=t4_start_xmit at cxgb4_main.c:3243, held to 1546) and cxgb4_ptp_read_hwstamp (cxgb4_ptp.c:115); the only _bh site is teardown sge.c:3894 (medium confidence). All are the timer-softirq analogue of the seed's missing-BH-disable invariant: a timer softirq on the same CPU spins forever against a preempted process-context holder. Unresolved candidates left for follow-up: iwlwifi txq->lock stuck-timer, qdisc root_lock perturbation timers (sch_pie/sch_sfq/sch_red), libiscsi RX-path plain sites 1088/1197. The systematic whole-tree timer-callback enumeration was not run for s13 (halted by finalize directive); static analysis only, no build/lockdep/PoC (tree lacks .config).
